entities.name: Santa Maria della Concezione a Montecalvario, Naples
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Santa Maria della Concezione a Montecalvario is a church in central Naples, Italy. Founded as a small church in 1579, it was attached to the adjacent monastery and school of the Concezione. It is located on via Concezione a Montecalvario #32.
